modules.name: server-composition-root
modules.responsibility: Top-level wiring script that constructs every collaborator (engine hosts, HTTP/WS servers, OSC input, monitors, autosavers, telemetry, backups, tunnel) and owns the module-level mutable live state (project slot, show/song library slots, oscListen).
public_interface: (none — main.ts is a side-effecting entry module)
modules.notes: 801-line script with ~15 top-level closures over module-scope `let`s; it is the god-file of the server. Most 'logic' is glue, but non-trivial policy (stateMessage composition, OSC recall branch, stats adaptation, snapshot restore) lives here untested.

modules.name: engine-host
modules.responsibility: Legacy render-loop host that owns the core Engine, ticks it, tracks latency/fps stats, and pushes frames to the output manager.

modules.name: voice-engine-host
modules.responsibility: Voice-bus render host: owns kit/model/dmx-map rebuilds, show + transport state, the fixed-step loop, input translation, identify mode, and output/monitor sinks.
modules.notes: Very wide public surface (30+ methods) — many are thin per-field setters mirroring wire message types, which is what makes the handler a switch over setters.

modules.name: output-manager
modules.responsibility: Converts RGBA frames into universe byte packets under a patch/RGB order and fire-and-forget transmits them, with coalesced monitor sampling.

modules.name: ws-client-message-handler
modules.responsibility: Single dispatcher for every client→server WS message: editor gating, then per-message-type routing into hosts, libraries, backups, controller, tunnel and project IO.
modules.notes: Dispatch is a long if-chain on msg.t (20+ arms) rather than a table; deps interface is ~15 optional collaborators, several `?`-optional with silent no-op fallbacks.

modules.name: input-router
modules.responsibility: Pure translation layer from MIDI/OSC wire values to engine InputEvents and from CC/program/OSC addresses to show section-recall targets.
modules.notes: applyClientMessage (the legacy structural reducer) sits oddly alongside the pure input translation functions.

modules.name: client-registry
modules.responsibility: Tracks connected sockets and elects/hands off the single editor slot, producing per-client presence.

modules.name: pin-gate
modules.responsibility: Admission policy for WS/HTTP: room PIN lifecycle, host-token minting/validation, loopback and cloudflared detection, and the composed admit decision.
modules.notes: 14 exports for one policy question; the composed entry points are admitDecision + isTrustedHost, the rest are leaked internals used by tests and main.

modules.name: tunnel
modules.responsibility: Spawns and supervises the cloudflared share tunnel, parsing its URL from stdout and exposing start/stop plus a status/error report.
modules.notes: Two layers over one concern: TunnelControl is largely a status-caching pass-through in front of TunnelManager.

modules.name: controller-monitor
modules.responsibility: Discovers, adopts, polls and commands the PixLite controller, holding all adopted-controller state and broadcasting status/discovery to watchers.
modules.notes: ~12 pieces of closure-scoped mutable state plus async poll/identify/test-pattern flows in one factory; the returned object's shape is inferred (ReturnType), so its interface is implicit.

modules.name: persistence-project
modules.responsibility: Reads/writes the live project JSON on disk atomically and debounce-schedules autosaves off the render loop.
modules.notes: PROJECTS_DIR is a module-level constant evaluated at import time — an env-read frozen at first import.

modules.name: persistence-libraries
modules.responsibility: Generic versioned-blob file store plus two near-identical instantiations of it for the show and song libraries.
public_interface: load/save/saveAsync/inspect/path for show and song libraries
modules.notes: show-library.ts and song-library.ts are the same 50 lines twice, differing only in file name and type parameter.

modules.name: backups
modules.responsibility: Bundles project + both libraries into retained on-disk snapshots and restores them atomically, with an off-site record adapter.

modules.name: telemetry
modules.responsibility: Subscribes to monitor errors, dedups and envelopes them as reports, and ships them via a bounded retrying queue over HTTP.

modules.name: monitor-bus
modules.responsibility: In-memory retained event stream that stamps id/time on drafts, broadcasts them to clients, replays on connect, and seeds startup diagnostic rows.
modules.notes: Small module with a very wide blast radius — almost every other module takes a monitor sink.

modules.name: http-routes
modules.responsibility: Three host-token-gated HTTP endpoints handling native MIDI injection, desktop-shell diagnostic events, and OTA update status.
modules.notes: Each returns a boolean 'did I handle it' predicate; routing is a manual if-chain in main.ts rather than a router.

modules.name: static-host
modules.responsibility: Serves the built web dist over plain HTTP with SPA fallback and env-overridable root resolution.

modules.name: ws-protocol-codec
modules.responsibility: Encode/decode of the client and server WS message envelopes plus model/effect-spec serialization for the wire.
modules.notes: Mostly a re-export + thin JSON.parse/stringify facade over @ledrums/protocol.

modules.name: network-adapters
modules.responsibility: Enumerates the machine's NICs and recommends a controller IP on each adapter's subnet for the output setup panel.

modules.name: process-errors
modules.responsibility: Installs uncaughtException/unhandledRejection capture that routes process faults onto the monitor bus and returns an uninstaller.

seams.why: Every server capability (hosts, backups, controller, tunnel, adapters) reaches the handler through one injected deps object, so behaviour is fully substitutable in tests without touching the handler.
Clock, timer scheduler, HTTP client and probe are all injected, so polling and adoption can be driven deterministically.
Output transport construction is a function parameter, so Art-Net/sACN/fake sinks swap without editing the manager.
Process spawn is injected, so tunnel lifecycle is testable without cloudflared.

There is no `createServerApp(deps)` factory — the composition root is a top-level side-effecting script, so nothing inside it (stateMessage, OSC recall branch, stats adaptation, applyRestoredSnapshot, the HTTP if-chain) can be exercised or replaced without booting the process.

An import-time constant read from process.env doubles as the default argument for every persistence function, so the storage location is only overridable by parameter-threading and cannot change after first import.

seams.at: apps/server/src/main.ts HTTP dispatch (updateStatus → nativeMidi → hostEvent → static)
seams.why: Adding a route requires editing main.ts and a new module-level `let` handler slot; the boolean-predicate handlers imply a router that does not exist.

seams.at: apps/server/src/handlers/client-message.ts optional deps (tunnelControl?, controller?, backups?, listNetworkAdapters?, monitor?)
seams.why: Absent collaborators degrade to silent no-ops inside the handler, so the seam also encodes fallback policy — a wiring omission is indistinguishable from a legitimate no-op.
The generic store exists but show-library.ts and song-library.ts each re-wrap it with a duplicated hand-written function surface instead of exposing the store object, so a change must be made twice.

Per-field setters (setKitTransform/setKitGlobal/setHoopConfig/setKitOutputs/setKitNodeLayout/setOutput/setInputMap) mirror wire message types one-for-one, so every new message type forces a new host method and a new handler arm.

suspicions.hunch: At 801 lines with ~15 closures over module-level mutable state, main.ts changes for every unrelated reason — new route, new message, new persisted slot, new monitor source. Prime candidate for extracting a composable app factory.
These two files look like the same ~50 lines with the noun swapped, and main.ts duplicates the pairing again in three places (load/inspect, autosaver construction, stateMessage fields).

suspicions.where: apps/server/src/main.ts autosaver construction (three createAutosaver calls with near-identical monitor hooks)
suspicions.hunch: The onScheduled/onSaved/onError monitor triples differ only in a destination string — a factory is begging to exist.

suspicions.where: apps/server/src/handlers/client-message.ts (20+ `if (msg.t === ...)` arms) and apps/server/src/main.ts monitorInput (switch over the same tags)
suspicions.hunch: The same message-tag taxonomy is switched on in at least two places, so a new message type must be added in both or it silently goes unmonitored.
knip flagged both as unused exports; songLibraryPath/saveShowLibrary/saveSongLibrary/saveProject (sync variants) look like the same category and are worth sweeping together.
TunnelControl mostly caches status/url/error and forwards start/stop to TunnelManager; the second layer may not be earning its place.
decodeClient/encodeServer plus type re-exports read as a thin facade over @ledrums/protocol — check whether anything but JSON.parse/stringify happens here.

suspicions.where: apps/server/src/pin-gate.ts (pin, host token, remote address, url all as raw strings)
suspicions.hunch: Security-relevant identities are bare strings threaded through 14 exports; an argument-order mistake between pin and token would typecheck.

suspicions.where: apps/server/src/main.ts statsTimer (setInterval at 10ms broadcasting full stats to all clients)
suspicions.hunch: A 100Hz JSON broadcast with no backpressure or overlap guard; if serialization or a slow socket exceeds 10ms the timer queue grows unbounded.
Boot throws on a corrupt or dangling-ref live project file with (apparently) no fallback to the seed, so one bad autosave could make the server unbootable for a drummer with no terminal.
Restore replaces project and both libraries with only a `typeof version === 'number'` gate on the library blobs; a partially-written snapshot may be adopted as valid.
A protocol-message reducer living inside the otherwise-pure MIDI/OSC translation module; likely a source of one of madge's cycles between handlers, input-router and the hosts.
The generic blob store depending on the project module's env-derived constant is a plausible import cycle and couples two unrelated concerns.
Six optional deps with no-op fallbacks suggest configurations that never actually occur in production wiring — main.ts appears to always supply them.

The same cluster (host, voiceHost, clients, autosavers x3, tunnelControl, monitor) is passed as a bag to boot, to the message handler, and reassembled in stateMessage — an implicit 'ServerContext' object that has never been named.
Two parallel hosts kept alive behind a mode flag, with main.ts branching on `voiceHost ?? host` in many places; if voice mode is now the real path the legacy host may be carried dead weight.

items.coverage_notes:
Read in full or substantially: main.ts (skimmed ~450 of 801 lines, all section headers and top-level function list), handlers/client-message.ts (deps interface + dispatch skeleton, not each arm's body), controller-monitor.ts (factory head + state, not the discovery/identify/test-pattern bodies), voice-engine-host.ts (method signature list only, no bodies). Export surfaces were read for all 35 non-test source files.

Not read at all (mapped from export names, file size and imports only): output-manager.ts internals, engine-host.ts internals, backups/snapshot-store.ts internals, all four telemetry files, static-host.ts, network-adapters.ts, process-errors.ts, autosave.ts, atomic-file.ts, named-blob-store.ts, diagnostics.ts, monitor.ts, output-monitor.ts, the three http/ handlers, handlers/voice-input.ts, handlers/projects.ts. Depth ratings for those are inferred from LOC-to-export ratio, not verified.

No test files were read, so I cannot say which of the 72.3% coverage gap sits where — the suspicions are not coverage-informed. I did not re-run madge, so the specific 6 cycles are unconfirmed; the two cycle hunches (input-router/handlers, named-blob-store/projects) are inferred from import statements alone. telemetry/envelope.ts returned as a binary match to grep and its exports were not enumerated beyond what main.ts imports.
